versions.content: Support Service Configuration of AUTOSAR SW Components Type: valid Description: ECU Configuration shall support configuration of the interface between the AUTOSAR SW Components and the AUTOSAR Services. Rationale: During the configuration of an ECU, specific values for AUTOSAR SW Components service access need to be configured. Use Case: The SW Component requires NVRAM Blocks with symbolic IDs. The NVRAM Manager configuration is assigning specific ID values and needs to configure those values in the SW Component. Dependencies:  Supporting Material: 
